descripcion_geo: Hill between the city of David and the Temple Mount in Jerusalem; elite residential area and guard.
importancia_estrategica: Neighborhood between the city of David and the Temple; residence of the Temple servants.

historias.descripcion: King Jotham of Judah built the upper gate of the Temple and carried out many works on the Ophel wall.
King Manasseh, after his conversion, built an outer wall from the City of David to Ophel.

historias.titulo: The Temple servants lived in the Ophel
historias.descripcion: In Nehemiah's reconstruction, the Temple servants (Nethinites) lived in the Ophel.

personajes.descripcion: He carried out important constructions in Ofel; He was a faithful king who did not enter the Temple improperly.
After his conversion in exile, he reinforced the Ophel.
He assigned the Ophel to the Temple servants in the reconstruction.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Ophel: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The Ophel: between the king and the Temple

judaismo.descripcion: The Ophel is the intermediate space between the royal residence (city of David) and the place of worship (Temple); symbol of the gray area between political power and worship.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Ophel is the intermediate space between the royal residence (city of David) and the place of worship (Temple); symbol of the gray area between political power and worship.
